name: Android

Camera/folder backup, Sync Pairs, Nearby Share
Biometric App Lock, up to 5 paired desktops
installNote: Not on the Play Store — allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser/files app. This build is signed with the default Android debug keystore, not a release key.
